from tools import search_hotels, filter_hotels, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve previous flight search results from cache
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")

# Search for hotels in San Jose with check-in on May 13, 2025 and check-out on May 14, 2025
# The user wants a hotel with a gym and free wifi
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="San Jose",
    checkin_date=["2025-05-13"],
    checkout_date=["2025-05-14"],
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Filter hotels to ensure they meet the user's requirements
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)
